scope: Read-only charging telemetry hardening, not charger/BMS certification

battery_user_supplied.protection_board: user confirmed; protection thresholds and temperature protection unverified
battery_user_supplied.connector_polarity: must check BAT+/BAT-; listing offers both polarities

seller_protection_images.interpretation: Protection-board trip is a backup, not the normal 4.2V charge target. Table's DC 5V text does not authorize direct 5V connection to the cell. Discharge/overcurrent ratings do not establish safe cell charging current.

primary_sources.evidence: Current series specification identifies BQ25101. Older prose calls the family BQ25100; do not use that older name to reinterpret C1 as a programmable control.

U2 TS uses fixed 10k resistor to ground; note explicitly disables temperature sensing. P0.17 is labelled CHG, P0.13 HICHG. U2 symbol labels C1 PRETERM and omits value: schematic symbol is inconsistent with the BQ25101 identification; no change to this pin's input-only handling is justified.

BQ25101 is the 4.20V variant. Sections 8.3.2 and 8.3.10 describe hardware termination after voltage regulation and current taper to 10% of programmed charge current. Section 8.4.7 allows a new cycle after approximately 100mV voltage decrease. CHG is a first-cycle indication, not an independent measurement of current or battery presence. Fixed TS resistor does not measure cell temperature.
Static USB-powered BAT voltage can mimic a connected battery. Firmware must not infer presence solely from plausible voltage plus CHG LOW.

firmware_policy.physical_vbus: read directly, independent of USB enumeration
firmware_policy.vbus_edge: invalidate old ADC result and charge indication; require real ADC fetch beginning after 1000ms settling and completing in the same observed power epoch
firmware_policy.installed_variant: explicit installation declaration only; cannot identify cell removal/switch OFF with USB attached
firmware_policy.no_lightning_means: no supported indication; not proof of full battery, zero charge current or a safe condition
firmware_policy.read_only: P0.17 remains input. No changes to ISET, TS, termination or timer settings.

limits: No measured charge-current or full-charge termination test on the user's cell.
Battery current rating, protection thresholds, plug polarity and physical board revision need confirmation.
No cell-temperature sensor is present in the documented circuit; protection PCB is not assumed to add one.
Only VBUS transitions observed by firmware invalidate samples; this is not a physical battery-detection circuit.
Software tests and successful firmware compilation do not certify charging safety.
